title: Cyclic Quadrilateral: Exterior Angle
body:
PQRS is a cyclic quadrilateral. Side PQ is produced to T.

Given: $$\angle QPR = 35°$$ and $$\angle PRS = 42°$$.

a) Calculate $$\angle PSR$$ (angle subtended by the same arc PR).
b) Calculate $$\angle RQT$$ (exterior angle of cyclic quadrilateral).
